newsitem.title: USA: Couple urges Algiers Bancorp to seek merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Couple urges Algiers Bancorp to seek merger deal.

text.p: Greenwich, Conn., investors Jerome and Susan Davis said Wednesday they urged Algiers Bancorp Inc to explore opportunities to merge with a larger financial institution.
The couple, who specialize in banking investments, said they advised Algiers to take this step if Algiers "cannot triple the substandard four-percent return on equity."
The Davises, who hold a 9.98-percent stake in the New Orleans-based banking company, said they originally held the stake for investment.

But they said that, based on their review of the company's financial results for the quarter ending September 1996, they now believe that Algiers must consider several options which will enhance shareholder value, including a merger transaction.
